text: Everyone shifted to the ball, so the far side is empty. Switch it: X, or LB + RB + X for a driven one.
Their pressers are behind you and still turning. Drive forward with RT and attack the space.
He is close enough to block it. Fake shot first (B then A), then shoot with space.
Your CB stepped out and left a gap. Since update 1.4.0 the Squad Battles CPU goes forward quicker. Hold your line and switch (LB) to the CB nearest the runner.
Their midfielder arrives late at the edge of your box. In FC 26 your AI teammates mark the edge loosely, so close him yourself while the pass travels.
Everyone shifted to the ball, so their far winger is free. A long switch is on. Keep your far full-back close enough to step out.
Their winger has the touchline. Get your full-back goal-side, jockey him outside, and keep your CBs in the box.
Chip shots got more accurate in FC 26 update 1.5.0, so a keeper who charges all the way gets chipped. Bring him halfway and make the striker decide.
No space ahead and two of them closing. Sprinting into them loses it. Pass, then move into space.
He’s too far off to block it. Shoot now: low driven (double-tap B) to the far post.
